findings.text: Verified new_starvation/unaccepted_err from the full rows. Cycles 0-1 are reset rows. From cycle 6, m0 holds write 0x05/SEL5 with pre o_mstall=1. At cycle 8, pre o_merr=1 while pre o_mstall is still 1. At cycle 9, CYC drops. This matches the ledger, and HR case (i) holds. The paired unaccepted_ack fixture has the same rows with o_mack instead. Treating that ACK as invented is consistent with K6, because ACK never uses branch B. The asymmetry rests only on header lines 37-39, which mention a bus error and not an ACK. It is properly labelled inferred.

Verified err_boundary/acceptance_edge. The request is held at cycles 6-7 under pre o_mstall=1. At cycle 8, pre o_mstall=0 and pre o_merr=1, so a master acceptance and an ERR occur in the same row. Row 7 was held with an identical projection, so HR case (ii) holds. Branch A has no entry from rows <8 and dies. B1 and B2 survive. The CYC drop at cycle 9 cancels the B1 entry. No pending work remains, so unresolved is correct.

Verified err_boundary/cyc_withdrawal_edge. Pre i_mcyc[0] is 1 at cycle 8 and 0 at cycle 9, with pre o_merr=1 at cycle 9. The K13 same-edge rule applies, and it is not overlapped by the HR rule, because CYC is low. Post o_merr at cycle 8 is correctly not treated as a transfer.

Verified err_boundary/old_live_and_held_request. Events: accept at 6, slave accept at 8, held write with pre o_mstall=1 at cycles 9-14, pre o_merr at 10, slave ACK at 12, master ACK at 13 with 0xABCDEF12, CYC drop at 15. Branch A retires the read as unexplained_mapped_err, then dies at the cycle-13 ACK because no entry remains. Branch B survives. No owner is chosen by convenience. The CYC-drop withdrawal of the held write is not a K11 violation.

Under HR case (i), branch B allows an unbounded number of ERRs during a single held request without any refutation. All of them carry the unknown tag, so this is sound. Reports should note that repeated ERRs during one hold are never judged.

Verified new_prefix/clean_before_invalid_input. The held address changes 5->7 at cycle 16, while pre o_mstall=1 and CYC is high, so e=16. The prefix accepts at 6, forwards at 8, and ACKs at 10 with correct data, so prefix_scoped_pass is consistent. In earlier_data_change, the bad data at cycle 10 lies before e, so dut_violation is retained per rule (1).

parent_list_before has 10 items. The exact before-text occurs only at index 9, so it uniquely selects index 9. The per-slave invariant at index 8 survives. The after-text is identical to the model patch. Scope is unchanged.

The K2 and K10 identity projections handle read data and SEL-disabled lanes consistently, as the new_payload fixtures show. On exhaustion, association judgments are suspended without pruning, and the count projections remain exact with explicit overflow handling. Unknown-tag classification is generic and defaults new tags to unknown. K5 and C1-C4 are explicitly excluded.

required_changes.text: In reports, document that multiple HR ERRs within one held request are all absorbed by branch B and never judged.
